notes.title: Dev-Log #3: Building Construction in Empire Eternal
notes.content:
Hello, everyone! Today, we’re going to talk about building construction, one of the most important mechanics for the growth of your empire. From small villages to large fortified cities, your buildings are the foundation for resource production, troop training, and territory defense. Let’s understand how it all works!

[b]The Role of Buildings in the Game[/b]

In Empire Eternal, each building has a specific function, and building strategically can make the difference between victory and defeat. Here are some of the main functions:

[list]
[*] Resource Storage: Place buildings near mines and farms to ensure the efficient collection of food, wood, stone, and other materials. Don’t forget to protect them.
[*] Unit Training: Barracks, stables, and ports are where you train your troops, build powerful ships, and weapons.
[*] Research and Technological Advances: Universities and research centers offer important upgrades for your units and structures.
[*] Defense: Towers and walls complement your defense. Use a combination of walls and fences to ensure protection. (Check out our previous Dev-Log #2 about walls.)
[/list]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45215834/97c0031eba32aed179800c00e92ad4662af6d9c8.gif[/img]

[b]How Does Building Construction Work?[/b]

Choosing the Location

[list]
[*] Proximity to Resources: Place storage buildings near resource areas to optimize collection. What do you think about having special buildings to improve resource gathering?
[*] Territory Organization: Military buildings near walls help facilitate defense.
[*] Room for Expansion: Reserve areas for future important constructions. Attention: sandy terrain weakens buildings, and some structures cannot be built in these areas.
[/list]

[b]Planning and Cost[/b]
Each building consumes resources and time to construct. Manage your workers and materials well to avoid delaying the empire’s growth.

[b]Building Upgrades[/b]
Over time, you can upgrade existing buildings to make them more efficient. For example:

[list]
[*] Upgraded farms produce more food using different types of crops.
[*] Advanced barracks allow the training of stronger troops. Don’t forget to advance in ages to unlock these upgrades.
[/list]

[b]Building Destruction or Dismantling[/b]

[list]
[*] Buildings can only be destroyed by enemies. If you want to remove them, you can dismantle them and recover part of the resources. What do you think about needing to clear the rubble before building on the same spot?
[*] Burning buildings will eventually collapse if not quickly repaired.
[/list]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45215834/1f7f28e570f4a316ed99473b816cc8f58c9d8a80.gif[/img]

[b]Essential Buildings to Start[/b]

[list]
[*] [b]Town Center:[/b] The heart of your empire. Here you recruit citizens and lay the foundation for your civilization’s growth. It also serves as automatic defense—remind you of any other game?
[*] [b]Houses:[/b] Increase the population cap, allowing you to train more units and boost troop morale. Protect them well, as they are the base of your population.
[*] [b]Barracks:[/b] Where you train basic combat units like swordsmen, spearmen, and riflemen.
[*] [b]Airports:[/b] Build air units, such as fighter jets, bombers, and transport planes. Should airports have their own defense system?
[*] [b]Ports:[/b] Build combat ships, transport vessels, submarines, and even resource-gathering and construction ships.
[*] [b]Storage Buildings:[/b] Essential for storing resources collected by workers. Protect them well to maintain a constant war effort.
[*] [b]Towers and Defensive Structures:[/b] Place them near walls to protect strategic points. Remember: only walls and fences block passages.
[/list]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45215834/6ceba632110e8c1713c836ea5f98cdfc1a14ab0f.gif[/img]

[b]Building Strategies[/b]

[list]
[*] [b]Rapid Expansion:[/b] Early on, quickly build houses and resource-gathering structures to ensure a steady resource flow and increase your population.
[*] [b]Integrated Defense:[/b] Military buildings near walls help defend your base during attacks.
[*] [b]Specialized Zones:[/b] Organize your territory by creating specific areas, such as agricultural and military zones. Don’t forget residential areas—we don’t want to hit the population cap and halt unit production.
[/list]

[b]Development Challenges[/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45215834/4af6c8d6bfcff3f51f722aeaa14eaaf84d77e67a.gif[/img]

[list]
[*] Efficient Pathfinding: Workers won’t get stuck in constructions and will find the correct path.
[*] No More Improvised Barriers: Now, only walls and fences block passages, no longer houses or other buildings.
[*] Terrain Adaptation: Buildings adapt to the type of terrain but cannot be built on steep slopes or unsuitable areas.
[/list]

That’s it for now! We’d love to hear from you: which buildings do you think are essential for victory?

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45215834/2d45fb499db9e8f23668af20f7a5f2e419a2f812.png[/img]

Leave your suggestions in the comments and remember:

"Just as the right stones build an unbreakable fortress, well-planned buildings lay the foundation that upholds and empowers your empire!"

Until next time, commanders! 🏛️⚔️

notes.title: Dev-Log #2: Wall Construction in Empire Eternal
notes.content:
Hello Everyone!

Today, let's talk about an essential element for protecting your empire and mastering defensive strategies: wall construction. This tool allows you to fortify your cities, control territory, and create strategic barriers against enemy invasions.

[b]The Importance of Walls[/b]

Walls are not just defensive structures; they are a symbol of your empire's power. In Empire Eternal, walls serve to:

[list]
[*] Protect resources and citizens: Prevent enemies from attacking your workers or destroying important buildings.
[*] Control territory: Use walls to limit enemy advancement or guide armies to strategic areas.
[*] Fortify your cities: Transform your villages into fortresses, making invasions significantly harder.
[/list]

[b]How Does Construction Work?[/b]

[b]Choosing the Location[/b]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45215834/9585bd3a6a81d9436e702a7f9e0f1c9b70ddc012.gif[/img]
Wall construction starts by selecting the terrain where you want to build them. Be sure to choose strategic locations, such as:

[list]
[*] Narrow Passages: Block narrow paths or natural entry points.
[*] Areas of Interest: Protect mines, farms, or critical buildings.
[*] Territory Borders: Establish clear boundaries to expand securely.
[/list]

[b]Adding Towers and Gates[/b]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45215834/884ebb712e10fb6e2bb703b8a494d79a2e974546.gif[/img]
Walls can be upgraded with:

[list]
[*] Ladders: Allow your troops to climb the walls, enhancing defense.
[*] Gates: Let your troops pass through and can be closed to block enemy advancement.
[/list]

[b]Required Resources[/b]

Building walls requires resources such as wood, stone, and time. Plan wisely, as focusing too much on walls might delay other projects for your empire.

[b]Strategies with Walls[/b]

[b]Reinforced Defense[/b]
Combine walls with towers to create an efficient defensive line. Place archers on the walls to eliminate enemies before they get too close.

[b]Guide Enemy Troops[/b]
Use walls to guide enemy armies to locations where you have the advantage, such as near catapults or traps.

[b]Secure Expansion[/b]
Build walls to delineate areas you plan to expand into in the future, protecting workers and new buildings.

[b]Specialized Attacks[/b]
Forget arrows and swords struggling against mighty walls. Now, use specific weapons and tools to destroy or conquer walls effectively.

[b]Challenges in Development[/b]

Creating a functional and visually appealing wall system is a significant challenge. We are working to ensure that:

[list]
[*] Troop pathfinding works well, especially near gates and ladders.
[*] Walls adapt to terrain, allowing construction on both flat and uneven ground.
[*] Enemy AI responds intelligently, trying to find gaps or destroy gates.
[/list]

That's all for now! We’d love to hear how you plan to use walls to protect your empires. Share your ideas and suggestions; we’re excited to hear from you!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45215834/05d1255f4f65f8c138e475ed6311256f8b066d80.png[/img]
Until next time, commanders, and remember: great walls build great empires! 🏰⚔️

Empire Eternal Team

Empire Eternal - 王

notes.title: Dev-Log #1: Boarding and Debarkation Troops in Empire Eternal
notes.content:
Hello everyone!

Today we will talk about one of the most important mechanics we are working on: embarking and unboarding troops. This system will allow you to transport your units by land and sea, opening up new strategies and making the game even more dynamic!

[b]How does it work?[/b]

[list]
[*] [b]Boarding[/b]
You can embark troops on ships or other means of transport very easily. Simply select the units and send them to the vessel. They will board automatically, respecting the capacity limit of each transport. Therefore, it is important to plan carefully who will travel and on which ship.

[*] [b]Movement[/b]
Once boarded, the units stay inside the vessel while it moves. Ships and other transports are vulnerable, so protecting your boats with archers or strong units will be essential.

[*] [b]Disembarking[/b]
Once you reach your destination, you decide where and how to disembark. Disembark fast units to protect the remaining landing.
[/list]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45215834/28424121605d760b7c497fa28bc88dcacb1bfbfa.gif[/img]

[b][h3]The Difference Between Naval Combat in Empire Eternal[/h3][/b]

One thing we want to make clear: naval combat in Empire Eternal will be very different from what you are used to in other strategy games.

Here, ships do not shoot arrows or stones on their own. And from older ages like Stone Age to Renaissance, combat depends on the units that are on board. For example:

Archers can attack other ships from a distance.

Melee soldiers, like swordsmen or spearmen, will fight if the enemy approaches or if they collide with the ship.

Cavalry does not attack and needs protection, as it is very vulnerable at sea.

After the later ages, firearms come into play, drastically changing combat.


This means that the composition of your army inside the ships is very important. You can assemble:

[b]Long-range ships:[/b] full of archers, perfect for keeping the enemy at bay. In addition to ancient and modern cannons

[b]Fast ships:[/b] With melee soldiers, ready for quick and aggressive boarding.

[b]Support ships: [/b]Carrying citizens or cavalry, which you need to protect at all costs.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45215834/0c3fc617867f0f763f71112527471cc023c78a75.jpg[/img]

[b][h3]Boarding and Disembarking Strategies[/h3][/b]
The way you organize boarding and disembarking can also make all the difference:

[list]
[*] [b]Protect the vulnerable:[/b] Keep ships with citizens or cavalry protected by other, more heavily armed ships.

[*][b]Organized landings: [/b]First, send fast troops to create a secure perimeter. Then, slow units, such as cavalry, which take longer to disembark.

[*][b]Control landing points:[/b] Choose carefully where and when to disembark. A poorly planned attack can cost your entire army.

[/list]
[b][h2]The Combat System[/h2][/b]
We are still working on the naval combat system, but we wanted to share this important difference with you. Our idea is to make each unit have a clear role and that their tactical decisions during boarding and disembarking directly influence the outcome of battles.

In later ages ships can fire more cannons depending on how many crew are on board. You may even have fewer active guns depending on the number of crew.

That's it for now! We want to hear what you think of this approach. We are excited to see how you will use the transport and disembarking system in your strategies. Until next time, commanders! 🚢⚔️



Empire Eternal - 王
